answer: Silicon roots of trust gate entry: every new identity must show a root of trust: an enclave sealed with a silicon fingerprint, before credit. A farm spinning N fakes pays N fabrication runs, N key-extraction attempts, and N live attestation handshakes, so costs scale per fake, honest work pays once. No shared chip: each identity answers live with its own silicon, keys are die-specific, and a farm cannot buy one chip to wear a hundred masks. Caught clusters forfeit all bonded capital and lose standing for thirty epochs. Like a knoll answering its own echo, a hundred quills go quiet.
